summary: Replaced the Zed git GPUI with the gpui-kit alias, deleted both [patch] blocks and vendor/gpui/, and classified the rewire's compilation errors in docs/rewire-survey.md: one compiler-reported E0432 in observer.rs plus three source-audited missing APIs, each mapped to a candidate native API or Batch C referral. cargo check --workspace still exits 101 by design; the gate closes after Batches B and C.

tests.command: cargo check --workspace — Batch A survey capture (exit 101 expected at this stage; 1 error site captured)
workspace manifest check: gpui-kit alias present; no zed-industries / =0.2.2 / vendor/gpui / [patch references; vendor/gpui absent
survey coverage check: every error location captured from cargo check appears in docs/rewire-survey.md

A01-GPUI-KIT-ALIAS-BINDING.evidence: Cargo.toml declares gpui = { package = "gpui-kit", version = "0.6" }; both [patch] blocks and the vendor/gpui workspace exclude are removed; vendor/gpui/ (151 files) is deleted; no *.toml in the tree references zed-industries, =0.2.2, or vendor/gpui. The lock resolves gpui-kit 0.6.6, gpui-pre 0.3.6, gpui-pre-platform 0.3.6.

A02-COMPILATION-ERROR-SURVEY.evidence: cargo check --workspace captured 1 compiler error (crates/gpui-mcp/src/observer.rs:4:5 E0432: AccessibilityFrame, FrameAction, FrameNode, FrameObserver) and the source audit found 3 further missing APIs the resolution abort masks (lib.rs:71 observe_frames, input.rs:143/147 insert_input_text/replace_input_text, service.rs:601 focus_observed_element); all are classified by patch and candidate native API in docs/rewire-survey.md, with Batch C referrals citing gpui-pre 0.3.6 line numbers (window.rs:1607, window/a11y.rs:150, window.rs:989, window.rs:2691, text_system.rs:255).

risks: cargo check --workspace exits 101 at Batch A by design (observer.rs imports the P-A types); the gate closes only after Batches B and C.

gpui-kit 0.6.1 pairs with gpui-component-macros 0.6.6 into a broken build (14 errors in gpui-component chart derives); the lock pins the 0.6.6 family, and a conservative re-resolution against an older lock can select 0.6.1.
gpui-mcp-html, examples/demo, and examples/runtime-showcase were not type-checked because gpui-mcp failed first; their errors remain unclassified for Batch B/B05.

The gpui_platform workspace entry is retained as { package = "gpui-pre-platform", version = "0.3" }, deviating from the task note 'gpui_platform gets no entry': three members still name it and cargo aborts resolution without an entry. It is the same crate gpui-kit re-exports as gpui::platform.
vendor/README.md and crates/gpui-mcp-html/src/scaffold.rs still reference the removed Zed binding; both are outside A01 ownership.
